cap_disabled_title: Agents are turned off on this deployment
cap_disabled_description: The operator set {setting} to {value}: no agent can connect or act, whatever its grant. Grants and proposals are kept for when they're turned on.
cap_propose_title: Agents only propose in this deployment
cap_propose_description: The operator set {setting} to "{value}": every write an agent makes waits for a person to approve it, whatever its grant says.
cap_off_title: Agents only read in this deployment
cap_off_description: The operator set {setting} to "{value}": agents can't write, preview or propose. Grants keep their write scopes for when the cap is lifted.
blocked_extension_call: It stops where it would call {app} ({point}), which a preview can't do without the effect happening.
blocked_outbound_call: It stops where it would call out to another service, which a preview can't do.
blocked_media_storage: It stops where it would touch the media storage, which a preview can't do.
blocked_media_upload: It stops where it would hand out an upload link, which a preview can't do.
blocked_proposal: It stops where it would apply another proposal.
blocked_unknown: It stops at an effect a preview can't run.
event_product_deleted: Deletes product {product} with {count, plural, one {# variant} other {# variants}}
event_variant_updated: Changes variant {variant} of product {product}: {count, plural, =0 {its details} other {{fields}}}
event_stock_nothing: Stock of variant {variant} becomes nothing anywhere
event_stock_nothing_untracked: Stock of variant {variant} becomes nothing anywhere (not tracked)
event_prices_set: Sets fixed prices for {count, plural, one {# variant} other {# variants}} in price list {price_list}
event_prices_removed: Removes fixed prices of {count, plural, one {# variant} other {# variants}} from price list {price_list}
event_price_list_changed: Changes price list {price_list}: {count, plural, =0 {its details} other {{fields}}}
event_catalog_products_added: Adds {count, plural, one {# product} other {# products}} to catalog {catalog}
event_catalog_products_removed: Removes {count, plural, one {# product} other {# products}} from catalog {catalog}
event_catalog_price_lists_added: Adds {count, plural, one {# price list} other {# price lists}} to catalog {catalog}
event_catalog_price_lists_removed: Removes {count, plural, one {# price list} other {# price lists}} from catalog {catalog}
event_fulfillment_created: Ships {count, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}} of order {order} from {location}
event_fulfillment_created_notify: Ships {count, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}} of order {order} from {location} and emails the buyer
event_fulfillment_updated: Changes the tracking of a shipment of order {order}
event_fulfillment_cancelled: Takes back a shipment of order {order}; its units return to stock
event_category_products_added: Adds {count, plural, one {# product} other {# products}} to category {category}
event_category_products_removed: Removes {count, plural, one {# product} other {# products}} from category {category}
preview_changes_note_pending: The changes the write would record, in order. Nothing has changed yet.
preview_partial_pending: What it did up to there is shown; approving runs it in full, including that step.
preview_changes_note_applied: The changes the write recorded, in order, as previewed.
preview_partial_applied: What it did up to there was shown; it ran in full when approved.
preview_changes_note_not_applied: The changes the write would have recorded, in order. None was made.
preview_partial_not_applied: What it did up to there is shown.
preview_partial_title: Only part of this could be previewed
preview_stopped: It stopped at an effect a preview can't run.
preview_email_to_hidden: to a customer (address hidden from this agent)
preview_calls_description: Read-only calls, made for real while previewing (shipping rates, search, a payment's status).
list_description: AI agents that work in the admin through MCP. Their changes wait for approval unless you let them apply.
list_empty_description: Connect an MCP client (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) to the API's {path}, or create an autonomous agent with its own key for a job.
create_ready_subtitle: Copy its key now: you won't see it again.
create_subtitle: An autonomous agent works on its own, for a job, with the access you give it here.
create_key_warning_title: This is the only time the key is shown
create_key_warning_description: Give it to the agent's MCP client as its bearer token for the API's {path}. It works nowhere else. Lost it? Revoke the agent and create another.
create_name_description: Shown in the inbox beside what it proposes, so say what it's for.
grant_cap_propose: This deployment lets agents only propose ({setting}), so apply acts as propose.
grant_cap_off: This deployment lets agents only read ({setting}).
grant_lacks_scope: Your role doesn't have {scope}, so you can't give it.
grant_always_proposed: Always proposed: a person approves every use.
grant_store_description: What it may see and change. A change it proposes waits in the proposals inbox until someone approves it; one it applies is written at once. Propose is the default.
grant_personal_description: Off by default: without these, names, emails, phone numbers and addresses are left out of everything the agent reads.
grant_personal_warning_title: The agent's model provider sees what the agent reads
grant_personal_warning_description: Grant personal data only when the job needs it, and only if your agreement with that provider covers it.
grant_operations_description: Optionally, only these operations exist for the agent, within its scopes.
grant_operations_field_description: Operation IDs as the API documents name them, one per line, like {first} or {second}.
proposal_changed: This proposal changed since you opened it. Below is what it would do now: review it and approve again.
connect_expired: This request expired: requests wait ten minutes. Connect again from the client.
header_revoked_description: Its credentials stopped for good and its pending proposals can't be approved. What it did stays in the log.
header_capped_by_person: It never does more than {person}'s role allows
header_capped_by_staff: It never does more than its staff member's role allows
header_capped_description: A connected agent acts for the person who connected it: its grant is narrowed by their role at every request, and it stops if they're deactivated.
revoke_dialog_description: Its credentials stop at once and for good, and its pending proposals can't be approved any more. To pause it instead, turn it off. This can't be undone.
activity_empty_description: Every operation the agent calls shows up here, reads too, kept for 30 days.
connect_unanswerable_title: This request can't be answered here
connect_description: It asks to work in this store as an agent acting for you, {name}. Asked {time}.
connect_expired_description: Requests wait ten minutes for an answer. Connect again from the client.
connect_answered_once: Each request is answered once. To connect again, start from the client.
connect_go_back_to: After you approve, you'll go back to {host}.
connect_loopback_title: This client only runs on your own computer
connect_loopback_description: Its access goes to {host}, a program on this machine. That's expected for Claude Code, Cursor and other desktop or command-line clients you're connecting right now. If you didn't just start connecting one here, cancel: any program on this computer can call itself {name}.
connect_problem_description: The link may be old or mistyped. Start connecting again from the client (in Claude Code, {command}).
connect_name_description: How the agent shows in the admin and the proposals inbox, so say where it runs.
connect_requested: It asked for {scopes}. That's only a hint: you choose below.
connect_limits: It never does more than your own role allows, and it stops if your account is deactivated. Writes are proposals you approve unless you choose Apply.
connect_summary: Connecting sends {client} back to {host} with access to this store as set above. You can change or revoke it any time under Agents.
proposals_description: Changes agents want to make. Each shows exactly what it would do; nothing changes until someone approves it.
proposals_empty_description: When an agent proposes a change you can approve, it waits here with a preview of exactly what it would do.
proposal_stale_title: The store changed since this was proposed. Here's what it would do now.
proposal_stale_description: Approving found the write would no longer do what was first previewed, so nothing was applied{count, plural, =1 {} other { (# times so far)}}. The preview below is the new version: approve it, or reject it.
proposal_request_description: What approving sends, as the agent made it.
outcome_applied: Approved; the write did what was previewed.
outcome_applied_by: Approved by {person}; the write did what was previewed.
outcome_failed_description: The write answered with an error; nothing changed.
outcome_applying: Approved; its write is running. Reload in a moment to see how it went.
outcome_applying_by: Approved by {person}; its write is running. Reload in a moment to see how it went.
outcome_expired_description: Nobody decided it in time, so nothing was applied. The agent can propose it again.
decide_description: Approving applies exactly what's previewed below, or nothing if the store changed since. Rejecting tells the agent why, if you add a note.
decide_cannot_description: It needs {scopes}, which your role doesn't have.
reject_dialog_subtitle: Nothing is applied. The agent can read your note when it checks the proposal.
reject_note_placeholder: Prices end in .99 in this store; propose again with that.
